## About
South Bay Driveline is a driveline shop on Almaden Rd in San Jose. The work centers on driveshafts, from getting u-joints replaced to building a custom driveshaft for a modified or older vehicle.
If you can't bring the vehicle in, the shop can walk you through measuring your driveshaft so a new one can be built from scratch. We're rated 4.5 on Google from 85 reviews.

## Services
- Custom driveshaft: A driveshaft built for your vehicle. One reviewer had one made for a modified vintage truck.
- U-joints replaced: Worn u-joints swapped out on your existing driveshaft.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you build a driveshaft if I can't bring the vehicle in?
A: One reviewer said the shop provided directions for measuring a driveshaft so a new one could be built from scratch. Call us to talk it through.

Q: How early should I get in touch?
A: One reviewer noted the shop is busy and suggested reaching out as soon as you know what you need.

## What customers say

The son doesn't have the best communication or customer service skills, the pricing is a little high, but the job was done correctly and i am happy with the results. It took a little longer than it should have, but in the end, the work they did was clean and works well. You get what you pay for. You just need to be patient. I will happily pay more and wait longer for high quality results." (Sam Clark, 5/5)

They even provide you with directions on how to measure a driveshaft so that they can build one from scratch if necessary." (Brett Austin, 5/5)
